description: Read one server-authorized native people list with explicit master_contacts or crm_leads domain. Master-contact IDs are verified by the scoped native reader; CRM system-segment and receipt-verified reviewed-lead IDs must appear in the current bounded catalog. Unmarked manual CRM lists and company/unknown domains are unsupported. JWT session and CRM read access required; page is bounded and no provider calls or sends occur.
name: bamf.read_saved_people_list
